OK
Ender, please set your Name in Gerrit.

Hi Ed, sorry, I'm a bit confused. I have already set my name to 'Ender Hsieh' in the settings. Is it still appearing incorrectly on your end? 
Please let me know if there’s a specific field I should update. 
Thanks!
Yes, I"m seeing an unset name.  Please make sure "Full name" is set in your profile.

Done.
Could you see my name now?
ERROR level and log the ec ?
Done
Is this documented in PDI ?

You're right, this is not in PDI yet. I will add a 'PDI TODO' note in the commit message to track this. Once the PDI is updated and merged, I will update this commit message accordingly. Thanks for the reminder!
Done

Does this work ? You don't need
chassis_utils::chassisInterfaces ?
Yes, this works as is, but you're right—using chassis_utils::chassisInterfaces would be clearer and more consistent with the rest of the codebase. I'll update it in the next patchset. Thanks!

Sorry, I realized I had a slight mistake in my previous reply. In chassis_utils.hpp, chassisInterfaces is actually defined directly under namespace redfish, not inside namespace chassis_utils.

It currently works because this code is already within the redfish namespace, 
but would you prefer I change it to redfish::chassisInterfaces to make the source more explicit?
I changed to redfish::chassisInterfaces
Shouldn't we check for name of the metric?

Done. Changed to iterate through the subtree and match by filename() == "OperatingFrequency" instead of blindly taking subtree.front(). Also added a similar check for afterGetControlProcessorAssociation to verify the interface name.
Correction: For afterGetControlProcessorAssociation it's not checking the interface, it's checking the number of subtrees.
Are SettingMax/Min missed?
Yes. Thanks for the reminder
Please define this at top of the file.
Done
Why can't we use getAcceleratorDataByService to populate these properties?
Done

Done
